notes: Only official upstream sources are listed here.
Installers and downloads are cached under .deploy/portable/downloads and must not be committed.

windows.description: Install Node.js LTS through Windows Package Manager

linux.description: Install Node.js and npm through the system package manager
commands: if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs npm; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo dnf install -y nodejs npm; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo yum install -y nodejs npm; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo pacman -Sy --noconfirm nodejs npm; else echo 'No supported package manager found. Install Node.js from https://nodejs.org/en/download/'; exit 1; fi

windows.description: Install Git through Windows Package Manager

linux.description: Install Git through the system package manager
commands: if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo dnf install -y git; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo yum install -y git; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo pacman -Sy --noconfirm git; else echo 'No supported package manager found. Install Git from https://git-scm.com/downloads'; exit 1; fi

commands: if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y openssh-client; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo dnf install -y openssh-clients; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo yum install -y openssh-clients; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo pacman -Sy --noconfirm openssh; else echo 'No supported package manager found. Install OpenSSH client manually.'; exit 1; fi
